remarks: HIGHEST and BEST by MONDAY 3/30 at 12 NOON! Welcome to 19 Lyncrest Drive, a well-maintained 3-bedroom, 2 full bath ranch tucked away at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac in the desirable William Street neighborhood of Norwalk. This inviting home offers the ease of one-level living with a functional layout and comfortable, sun-filled spaces throughout. The main level features a bright living room, an eat-in kitchen with ample cabinetry, and three generously sized bedrooms, along with two full bathrooms. The finished lower level adds valuable flexible space-ideal for a family room, home office, gym, or guest suite. Enjoy outdoor living in the large, fully fenced backyard, perfect for entertaining, gardening, or pets. Additional highlights include ample storage and a peaceful setting with minimal through traffic. Conveniently located just minutes from beaches, shopping, schools, parks, and major commuting routes, this home offers the perfect blend of privacy and accessibility. A wonderful opportunity to own in a sought-after location with room to make it your own!
